title: Function Decorators
instructions: Practice creating and using function decorators for various purposes including timing, caching, and authentication.
steps: Create a timer decorator that measures and prints function execution time
Implement a cache decorator that stores function results to avoid recomputation
Build a retry decorator that automatically retries failed function calls
Create an authentication decorator that checks user roles before execution
Stack multiple decorators on a single function and observe execution order

validation.output: Should show timing information and cache usage

hints: Use time.perf_counter() for accurate timing measurements
Store cached results in a dictionary using function arguments as keys
Use try/except blocks in retry decorator to catch exceptions
Check user_role in kwargs for authentication
Decorators execute from bottom to top when stacked
